question: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
gold: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
gold0: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

d.request: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic? Include rows with no matching record in the joined table.
d.sql: WITH bond_counts AS (SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND LOWER(b.bond_type) IN ('double', '2') GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC) AS bond_rank FROM bond_counts) SELECT molecule_id, label AS carcinogenicity_label, double_bond_count FROM ranked WHERE bond_rank = 1;

c.request:
Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
Evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
c.sql: WITH bond_counts AS (SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label) SELECT molecule_id, double_bond_count, CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS carcinogenic FROM bond_counts WHERE double_bond_count = (SELECT MAX(double_bond_count) FROM bond_counts);

b.request: Among all molecules, including those with no matching bond records, does the molecule with the most bonds of type `' = '` have a label of `'+'`?
b.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS answer FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
